findings.title: Seed numeric items declare units (mol/L, g/mol, %) the authoritative grader cannot parse; a correct answer entered with its unit is graded unparseable
findings.where: src-tauri/src/lessons/grade.rs (UNITS table + check_numeric) vs authored units in src-tauri/resources/seed/stoichiometry.lesson (10 numeric items/steps: mol/L x4, g/mol x2, % x4)
findings.fix: Add molarity (mol/L, M), molar mass (g/mol) and percent (%) to grade::UNITS as their own dimension classes (or strip a trailing known-dimensionless unit before comparison), AND add a seed-validation assertion that every authored numeric `unit` round-trips through lookup_unit so authored keys can never again declare a unit the grader rejects. Confirmed: check_numeric("0.1 mol/L", 0.1, Some("mol/L"), rel) => Unparseable; check_numeric("80 %", 80.0, Some("%"), rel) => Unparseable; the bare-number path grades Correct.

findings.title: Seed numeric/worked-example answer keys are only structurally validated (finiteness), not recomputed, despite the LESSONS.md s4.6 claim of full recompute
findings.where: src-tauri/src/lessons/schema.rs::validate_item / validate_worked_example; coverage gap in src-tauri/src/lessons/tests.rs (only one numeric key spot-checked)
findings.fix: Recompute numeric keys from the shared molar-mass table in the shipped-seed test (balance items are already re-verified by verify_balance). All hand-verified keys are currently correct; this is a guard against a future wrong key, not a present defect.

findings.title: Exam-unlock gate counts checkpoint_passed progress rows rather than joining to the current set's lesson ids
findings.fix: Count only lesson_progress rows whose lesson_id is in the current set.lessons so a stale progress row for a removed lesson id cannot inflate the pass count. Harmless given stable in-bundle ids.

findings.title: Adaptive trainer updates server mastery from a client-computed verdict
findings.fix: Submit the raw trainer answer and let Rust grade it, so the practice/mastery and SM-2 schedule update from an authoritative server grade rather than a client boolean. Low-stakes: checkpoints, exam, and certificate all remain server-graded.

findings.title: Shuffled MC radiogroup lacks arrow-key roving focus
findings.fix: Each radio is individually Tab-focusable and activatable (WCAG 2.1.1 passes), but the ARIA radiogroup pattern expects Up/Down/Left/Right to move selection within one tab stop. Add roving tabIndex + arrow-key handling or use native <input type=radio>.

findings.title: README 'fourth view (Cmd3)' phrasing is momentarily confusing
findings.fix: Lessons is the fourth view but sits at Cmd3 (Chat moved to Cmd4). Clarify, e.g. 'a fourth view at Cmd3 (Chat moves to Cmd4)'.
